description: Retry the failed platforms of a post. By default retries every platform currently in a 'failed' state; pass platforms to retry only a subset. Optionally pass delay (seconds) to reschedule the retry instead of running it immediately. Errors if the post has no failed platforms.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (default 0 = immediate).

platforms.description: Only retry these platforms (must currently be failed). Default: all failed platforms.

postId.description: The id of the post with failed platforms to retry.

name: retry_post
title: Retry Post
